videoTypes.label: Gaming: real heads on game bodies
videoTypes.help: Photographic faces on stylised game characters (R.E.P.O., PEAK, Backrooms, Super Battle Golf, Bombanana).

planner.faces: photographic heads, slightly oversized, seated naturally on stylised game bodies; no human torsos unless the game's bodies are human
planner.render: stylised game world and bodies, photographic faces only

videoTypes.label: Gaming: co-op horror
videoTypes.help: Dark game world, monster reveal, bright readable faces.

planner.lighting: scene stays dark; faces lit frontally and clearly; monster selectively lit and readable

videoTypes.label: IRL stunt / challenge
videoTypes.help: Real-world photo look (McDonald's roof, remote island, buried plane).

planner.render: realistic, photographic, polished; not cartoon, not painterly, not over-HDR

videoTypes.label: Product showcase
videoTypes.help: Person plus products that must stay exactly as in the reference (Pokémon boxes).

planner.products: preserve packaging, text, branding and artwork exactly; only lighting, angle and shadow may change

videoTypes.label: Reaction / talking
videoTypes.help: Faces and one strong prop or background idea.

referenceRoles.label: Face
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} ONLY as the facial identity reference for {person}. One picture, one person.

referenceRoles.label: Composition (inspiration thumbnail)
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} ONLY for composition, layout, scale, framing, expression intensity and lighting style. Do NOT copy any person or identity from @{label}.

referenceRoles.label: World / gameplay
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} as the authoritative reference for the game's world, environment, art style, character bodies, clothing and props. Do not copy HUD, text, health bars, money counters or any interface.

referenceRoles.label: Thumbnail polish (house style)
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} only as the reference for thumbnail compositing: how photographic heads integrate into bodies, head scale, facial readability, bright frontal lighting and finish. Do not use its faces.

referenceRoles.label: Character / monster / mascot
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} as the authoritative design reference for {name}. Preserve its defining features; do not redesign it.

referenceRoles.label: Prop
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} as the authoritative reference for the {name}. Match its shape, proportions, colours and design language; do not make it generic.

referenceRoles.label: Product (exact)
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} as the strict reference for {name}. Preserve packaging colours, all visible text, branding, badges and artwork exactly. Only lighting, viewing angle and natural shadow may change.

referenceRoles.label: Environment / location
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} as the reference for the setting and background.

referenceRoles.label: Base image (Fix only)
referenceRoles.planner: Use @{label} as the base thumbnail. Preserve its composition and everything not being fixed.

cameraPresets.label: Wide angle, low-to-medium height
cameraPresets.planner: 18–22 mm wide-angle lens from a low-to-medium camera height

cameraPresets.label: Ultra-wide, mild fisheye, high drop
cameraPresets.planner: 14–18 mm ultra-wide lens, mild fisheye, camera slightly above and beside the action so the drop is visible

cameraPresets.planner: close dramatic wide-angle lens, faces very near the camera, strong depth

faceScale.rule: Nobody tiny or distant; a face inside a tent or far back loses likeness.
